project.description: Packages the dictionary-api image from the per-stack reactor lane and ships the tarball to the stack's S3 prefix. Requires a prior successful 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' for the same TARGET_STACK.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build - ${TARGET_STACK}" DICT_DIR="$MAVEN_WS/services/picsure-dictionary"
# Guard: this job does not compile; it needs the reactor's artifacts for THIS stack. if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] || ! ls "$DICT_DIR"/target/dictionary-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts for stack ${TARGET_STACK} -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt"
docker build --load \ -f "$DICT_DIR/bdc.Dockerfile" \ --build-arg DATASOURCE_URL="${DATASOURCE_URL}" \ --build-arg DATASOURCE_USERNAME="${DATASOURCE_USERNAME}" \ --build-arg SPRING_PROFILE="${SPRING_PROFILE}" \ -t "avillach/dictionary-api:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$DICT_DIR"
docker save "avillach/dictionary-api:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" | gzip > dictionary-api.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp dictionary-api.tar.gz "s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$TARGET_STACK/containers/dictionary-api.tar.gz"
